_comment: DLP-2 global entity pack (framework doc section 5) — format-only, no country/locale scope. Real severity/threshold tuning is a config edit here, not a code change. email's quantifiers are bounded (RFC 5321: local-part <=64, domain <=255) to avoid O(n^2) backtracking on adversarial non-matching input — found via stress testing (tests/test_dlp_stress.py), this ran on every request via the Fast Scan Layer. url/github_token/stripe_key/slack_token/generic_jwt were already O(n) (audited empirically, see test_dlp_stress.py) but their quantifiers are now capped anyway — defense in depth against a pathological single huge token/URL, not a complexity fix.
